checks: Requires actual COMPLETE receipt SHA and exact matching scope before opening saved patches.
Checks batch/visit/profile identities, top20 hash and patch byte hashes, with confined saved NPZ paths.
All nine selected profiles are shown across rank1/rank2/rank3 figures, three origin ON columns and six scan rows each.
Negative df reverses spectral pixels and gives ascending-Hz edges; zero marks the frozen selected track coordinate.
Extent0..16*18.253611008s gives correct elapsed scan-time bin centers.
Color limits use the1st/99th percentiles of each selected track across all six scans; labels identify normalized power minus saved flank, and disclaim calibrated SNR/signal inference.
Output files must not already exist.
operational_conditions: Save plots and rendering receipts outside scientific batch directories so combined QA exact output inventory remains valid.
Root must bind this source SHA and give a separate actual COMPLETE batch GO before rendering.
Rendering before independent empirical combined QA is visualization of saved exploratory profiles; root must visually inspect final images and preserve percentile scaling context.
limitations: Static review only; no rendered images inspected.
This renderer does not independently validate source cells, winning scores or full fixed-profile arithmetic; combined empirical QA performs the source-cell/arithmetic checks.
